title: Tipping on a Nile cruise
standfirst: Tipping on a Nile cruise has its own rules: crew gratuities are obligatory and separate from the price, while tips for guides and others are up to you. Here is how it works. This is part of our guide to [[up]].

sections.heading: Crew gratuities
paragraphs: Every Nile cruise collects a gratuity for the crew. It is obligatory, never included in the cruise price, and paid on board at check-out to the vessel’s front office. The rate is set by each vessel, at least US$5 per guest per night; Nilecruz shows it on each cruise.

sections.heading: Your guide
paragraphs: Tips for your guide are separate from the crew gratuity and are at your discretion. Give them at the end of the sightseeing, directly to the guide.

sections.heading: Others
paragraphs: Drivers, porters and boatmen on excursions often expect a small tip. Carry small notes in Egyptian pounds or US dollars.

faqs.q: Is the crew gratuity included in the price?
faqs.a: No. It is always separate, obligatory and paid on board at check-out.

faqs.q: How much should I tip my guide?
faqs.a: That is up to you; give it at the end of the sightseeing, directly to the guide.

seoDescription: How tipping works on a Nile cruise: the obligatory crew gratuity, tips for your guide, and small tips on excursions.
